title: refactor(app-shell): move ObjectView's leaf pieces into objectViewChrome.tsx (slice 3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VtKf3F9dzJPJM4RRtABaEc)_

Part of #25992 (slice 3 of the move-only split, under the standing claim and the seat's continuation note; slices 1 and 2 landed as #26152 and #26233, and the card stays open for the component body).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Seam table (measured on `main` 96635f57)

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` was 3254 lines. What was still module-level besides imports and the slice 1-2 re-exports:

| Piece | Kind | Who reads it | This slice |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ConsoleObjectViewProps` | exported interface | `ObjectView` / `ObjectViewInner`, `views/index.ts` type re-export, 4 tests by path | stays: it is the component's own props contract |
| `ObjectNotFoundState` | exported React component | the `ObjectView` wrapper, `console/AppContent.tsx` (imports it from `views/ObjectView.js`) | moves |
| `VIEW_TABS_MIN_WIDTH`, `viewTabsFitNow`, `useViewTabsFit` | file-local constant, function, hook | `ObjectViewInner` (the tab strip decision) | moves |
| `keepInlineEditModeForTheSession` (with its docblock) | file-local no-op callback | `ObjectViewInner` (the list's inline-edit toggle) | moves |
| `ObjectView`, `ObjectViewInner` | the component | | stays (later slices, by concern) |

No test reads any of the moved lines out of `ObjectView.tsx` as source text (checked over every test that reads `ObjectView.tsx`), so this slice needs no test edit at all.

## What moved

The contiguous block from the `ObjectNotFoundState` docblock through `keepInlineEditModeForTheSession` moves verbatim, in its original order, into a new sibling `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewChrome.tsx`. `ObjectView.tsx` imports `ObjectNotFoundState`, `useViewTabsFit` and `keepInlineEditModeForTheSession` back and re-exports `ObjectNotFoundState`, the one moved name it exported, from the same path. `useViewTabsFit` and `keepInlineEditModeForTheSession` gain the `export` keyword in the new module because the component still calls them; `ObjectView.tsx` does not re-export them, so it publishes no new name. `Table as TableIcon` leaves `ObjectView.tsx`'s lucide import with its only reader. The package entry is untouched. `ObjectView.tsx` goes from 3254 to 3171 lines.

Move-only proof: the multiset of non-blank lines of the base `ObjectView.tsx` equals new `ObjectView.tsx` plus `objectViewChrome.tsx`, after normalising the two added `export` keywords. The only differing lines are imports, the re-export and its comment, and the new module's header.

## Test edits

None.

## Verification

At 668d82f9, under the shared verify lock: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`; app-shell dependency closure build; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (src and `tsconfig.test.json`); 117 test files (every `views/ObjectView.*` test, every `console/__tests__/AppContent*` test, and every other test that reads `ObjectView.tsx` as source) passed, 1425 tests; Console build (turbo, 71/71 tasks). eslint on both source files: 0 errors. The 30 derived dispatch gates: all exit 0. The rest of the app-shell suite is left to CI `Test UI`: it reaches these names only through the unchanged import path.

## Acceptance notes

- `ObjectNotFoundState`'s docblock still says "this module's `ObjectView` draws it for an absence"; the wrapper that draws it is now in the sibling file. Kept verbatim because the slice is move-only.
- The inline-edit docblock sits directly above the view-tabs docblock, as it did in `ObjectView.tsx`; the order is unchanged.

Changeset: `.changeset/25992-objectview-chrome-split.md` (patch, `@object-ui/app-shell`).
